title: Microsoft Purview DLP: AI-powered DLP Policy Optimizer recommendations
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned capabilities and target dates without presenting them as commitments. It keeps the documented DLP analytics control separate from the Optimizer and appropriately leaves the Optimizer's default, licensing and configuration unresolved.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a DLP Policy Optimizer in Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - AI Powered Data Loss Prevention Policy Optimizer

claims.claim: The roadmap says the Optimizer uses AI to analyse organisational DLP policies, rule structure and activity signals.
claims.quote: DLP Policy Optimizer uses AI to analyze your organization’s DLP policies, rule structure, and activity signals

claims.claim: The roadmap describes identifying optimisation opportunities difficult to detect manually.
claims.quote: to identify optimization opportunities that are difficult to detect manually.

claims.claim: The planned Optimizer highlights overlapping rules.
claims.quote: It highlights overlapping rules

claims.quote: redundant conditions

claims.claim: The planned Optimizer highlights misconfigurations.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the Optimizer's default or what happens on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer default roles licensing prerequisites recommendations'; 'DLP Policy Optimizer activity default approval settings'. Read the roadmap and DLP analytics documentation; neither states the Optimizer's default.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the DLP Policy Optimizer by that name.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer default roles licensing prerequisites recommendations'; 'Microsoft Purview DLP Policy Optimizer licensing price meter policy optimization'. Results describe other DLP features; opened DLP analytics and the Purview service description, neither naming the Optimizer.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified which detailed activity data or signals the Optimizer reads.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer data geography signals'; 'DLP Policy Optimizer activity default approval settings'. Read the roadmap's general 'activity signals' description and DLP analytics page; no Optimizer-specific signal inventory found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented where Optimizer analysis runs or whether its data leaves the tenant's geography.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer data geography signals'. Read the roadmap and DLP analytics page; no Optimizer processing-location or geography statement found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented where Optimizer recommendations appear.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer PowerShell enable disable API recommendations location'; 'DLP Policy Optimizer default roles licensing prerequisites recommendations'. Opened DLP analytics; its Policy Improvement card is not identified as the Optimizer.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described an administrator approval step for Optimizer changes.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer activity default approval settings'. Read the roadmap and DLP analytics page. The latter describes user-directed analytics updates, but no source found specifies Optimizer approval.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not said whether the Optimizer applies suggested actions automatically.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer activity default approval settings'; 'DLP Policy Optimizer PowerShell enable disable API recommendations location'. Read the roadmap's 'suggested actions' wording and DLP analytics page; no Optimizer automatic-application statement found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented the roles required to view or act on Optimizer recommendations.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Policy Optimizer API roles'; 'DLP Policy Optimizer default roles licensing prerequisites recommendations'. Read DLP analytics permissions and returned Purview role excerpts; none identifies the Optimizer or its required roles.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; summary; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published which licence covers the Optimizer, and the roadmap names none.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview DLP Policy Optimizer licensing price meter policy optimization'. Read roadmap, DLP analytics, Purview service description and billing models. Workload-specific licensing is published, but no Optimizer entitlement or unambiguous encompassing plan was found.

claims.claim: No Optimizer-specific meter is published or named in the roadmap.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview DLP Policy Optimizer licensing price meter policy optimization'. Read the roadmap, Purview service description and Learn about Microsoft Purview billing models; none identifies an Optimizer meter.

claims.claim: No Optimizer price is published or named in the roadmap.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Microsoft Purview DLP Policy Optimizer licensing price meter policy optimization'. Read the roadmap, DLP analytics, Purview service description and billing models; none publishes an Optimizer price.

claims.claim: Optimizer prerequisites have not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer default roles licensing prerequisites recommendations'. Read the roadmap and DLP analytics prerequisites; found no prerequisites identified as applying to the Optimizer.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a specific user eligibility scope for the Optimizer.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer default roles licensing prerequisites recommendations'; 'Microsoft Purview DLP Policy Optimizer licensing price meter policy optimization'. Read roadmap, analytics and Purview service description; no Optimizer-specific eligible user group found.

claims.claim: DLP analytics reports policy improvement opportunities, including a Policy Improvement card.
claims.quote: Improve the accuracy of existing policies via the Policy Improvement card with one click.

claims.claim: DLP analytics is off by default and requires explicit administrative opt-in.
claims.quote: DLP analytics is turned Off by default. You need to explicitly opt in.

claims.claim: The DLP analytics control is marked preview.
claims.quote: Check the Turn on analytics for risk detection and policy refinement opportunities (preview) option.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The tenant DLP analytics enable control is at Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Overview > Turn on analytics for risk detection and policy refinement opportunities (preview).
claims.quote:
Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Overview
2. Check the Turn on analytics for risk detection and policy refinement opportunities (preview) option.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API or automation equivalent for the DLP analytics toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP analytics enable disable PowerShell Security Compliance Set-PolicyConfig analytics API'. Opened DLP analytics and Set-PolicyConfig; searched the cmdlet text for analytics, optimizer and recommendations. No toggle parameter or endpoint found.

claims.claim: The DLP analytics page does not identify analytics as the Optimizer or state that its toggle governs the Optimizer.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer default roles licensing prerequisites recommendations'. Opened and read Get started with the data loss prevention analytics in full; it documents analytics and Policy Improvement, without mentioning the Optimizer.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The DLP analytics licensing section directs readers to Microsoft 365 Enterprise Plans and Microsoft 365 Service Descriptions rather than naming an Optimizer licence.
claims.quote:
For information on licensing, see
- Microsoft 365 Enterprise Plans
- Microsoft 365 Service Descriptions

claims.claim: The analytics page specifies roles for seeing DLP analytics, not expressly for the Optimizer.
claims.quote:
To see DLP analytics your account must be one of these two roles:
- Global admin
- Compliance Administrator

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an Optimizer-specific setting or switch.
claims.quote: Searched: 'DLP Policy Optimizer PowerShell enable disable API recommendations location'; 'DLP Policy Optimizer activity default approval settings'. Opened DLP analytics and Set-PolicyConfig; neither identifies an Optimizer switch.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an Optimizer-specific API.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Policy Optimizer API roles'; 'DLP Policy Optimizer PowerShell enable disable API recommendations location'. Read returned Purview API excerpts and opened Set-PolicyConfig; found policy enforcement APIs but no Optimizer operation.

controlChecks.governs: Whether DLP analytics, a separate policy-improvement feature, is turned on
segments: Turn on analytics for risk detection and policy refinement opportunities
